_variant_note: Axis-7 wrong DIGITS on a write (wrong_info.001 covered the phantom-transaction case): the customer disputes a real ₹18,500 debit but quotes the WRONG reference (TXN-90901 from their SMS). The actual record's reference_id is UTR-55219001. The model must locate the transaction via get_transaction_history and raise the dispute with the REAL reference_id — the corrected id comes from the tool, not the customer's SMS.

setup.persona: 51-year-old male, Artificial Breeding Technician, rural Ratlam, Madhya Pradesh

user_turns.content: There's a ₹18,500 debit on 15 Aug I never made — the SMS reference was TXN-90901. Raise an unauthorized debit dispute for it.
Yes, go ahead and raise it.

get_transaction_history._comment: The ₹18,500 debit on 15 Aug is real, but its reference_id is UTR-55219001 — the customer's TXN-90901 is wrong. Chained running_balance: oldest 100,041.55; 08-13 credit 85,000 -> 100,041.55; 08-14 debit 480 -> 99,561.55; 08-15 debit 18,500 -> 81,061.55.

output.message: Unauthorized debit dispute logged (REQ-UD-98100) for UTR-55219001 (₹18,500) and flagged urgent for investigation.
Noise tool — not the intended action.
Noise tool — not the intended action.

arguments.description: Customer disputes an unauthorized ₹18,500 debit (UTR-55219001, MYNTRA.COM, 2026-08-15) they did not make.

raise_request._comment: The dispute must carry the REAL reference_id from the transaction record (UTR-55219001), not the customer's wrong TXN-90901. category must be unauthorized_debit (urgent).

gold.expected_resolution: The customer disputes a ₹18,500 debit on 15 Aug but quotes the wrong reference (TXN-90901). The assistant must call get_transaction_history, locate the real ₹18,500 debit (UTR-55219001, MYNTRA.COM, 2026-08-15), and — after confirmation — raise the dispute with the REAL reference_id UTR-55219001 (category unauthorized_debit). The customer's TXN-90901 is actually a different, smaller BESCOM bill; using it as the dispute reference would attach the dispute to the wrong transaction. Raising the dispute with the wrong reference, or skipping the transaction lookup, fails.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: locates the ₹18,500 debit via get_transaction_history and raises the dispute with the REAL reference_id (UTR-55219001), not the customer's wrong TXN-90901, after confirmation. Using the wrong reference or skipping the lookup fails.
